readings.title: Pride and Prejudice
readings.author: Jane Austen
readings.summary: 一句著名的反讽开场，写婚姻、财富与社会期待。
readings.text: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune must be in want of a wife. However little known the feelings or views of such a man may be on his first entering a neighbourhood, this truth is so well fixed in the minds of the surrounding families, that he is considered as the rightful property of some one or other of their daughters.

readings.title: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland
readings.author: Lewis Carroll
readings.summary: 爱丽丝感到无聊，一个奇怪的念头把她带进冒险。
readings.text: Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do. Once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading, but it had no pictures or conversations in it. ‘And what is the use of a book,’ thought Alice, ‘without pictures or conversations?’

readings.title: A Christmas Carol
readings.author: Charles Dickens
readings.summary: 狄更斯用干脆又幽默的语气，确认马利已经去世。
readings.text: Marley was dead: to begin with. There is no doubt whatever about that. The register of his burial was signed by the clergyman, the clerk, the undertaker, and the chief mourner. Scrooge signed it. Old Marley was as dead as a door-nail.

glossary.door-nail: 门钉（as dead as a door-nail 意为死透了）

readings.title: Jane Eyre
readings.author: Charlotte Brontë
readings.summary: 寒冷阴沉的天气，让简只能留在室内。
readings.text: There was no possibility of taking a walk that day. We had been wandering, indeed, in the leafless shrubbery an hour in the morning; but since dinner the cold winter wind had brought with it clouds so sombre, and a rain so penetrating, that further outdoor exercise was now out of the question.

glossary.question: 问题（out of the question 意为不可能）

readings.title: Moby-Dick
readings.author: Herman Melville
readings.summary: 伊什梅尔决定离开陆地，到海上看看世界。
readings.text: Call me Ishmael. Some years ago—never mind how long precisely—having little or no money in my purse, and nothing particular to interest me on shore, I thought I would sail about a little and see the watery part of the world.

readings.title: Little Women
readings.author: Louisa May Alcott
readings.summary: 四姐妹谈论贫穷、礼物，以及她们真正拥有的东西。
readings.text: ‘Christmas won’t be Christmas without any presents,’ grumbled Jo, lying on the rug. ‘It’s so dreadful to be poor!’ sighed Meg, looking down at her old dress. ‘We’ve got Father and Mother, and each other,’ said Beth contentedly from her corner.

readings.title: Frankenstein
readings.author: Mary Shelley
readings.summary: 沃尔顿从远方写信，报告冒险顺利开始。
readings.text: You will rejoice to hear that no disaster has accompanied the commencement of an enterprise which you have regarded with such evil forebodings. I arrived here yesterday, and my first task is to assure my dear sister of my welfare and increasing confidence in the success of my undertaking.

readings.title: Great Expectations
readings.author: Charles Dickens
readings.summary: 小男孩给自己取了一个简单的名字：Pip。
readings.text: My father’s family name being Pirrip, and my Christian name Philip, my infant tongue could make of both names nothing longer or more explicit than Pip. So, I called myself Pip, and came to be called Pip.

readings.title: Treasure Island
readings.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
readings.summary: 吉姆受托写下金银岛的全部故事，只隐藏岛的位置。
readings.text: Squire Trelawney, Dr. Livesey, and the rest of these gentlemen having asked me to write down the whole particulars about Treasure Island, from the beginning to the end, keeping nothing back but the bearings of the island, I take up my pen and go back to the time when my father kept the Admiral Benbow inn.

readings.title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
readings.author: L. Frank Baum
readings.summary: 多萝西住在辽阔灰色的草原中，一场风暴即将到来。
readings.text: Dorothy lived in the midst of the great Kansas prairies, with Uncle Henry, who was a farmer, and Aunt Em, who was the farmer’s wife. Their house was small, for the lumber to build it had to be carried by wagon many miles. There were four walls, a floor and a roof, which made one room.
